name: assign to the nearest centre, then move centres to their members' mean
mechanism: pick initial centres, assign every point to its nearest centre, replace each centre by the mean of its assigned points, and repeat until assignments stop changing

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Linde–Buzo–Gray algorithm' in section Computational science / Statistics: a vector quantization algorithm to derive a good codebook

fails_when: initialisation decides the local optimum; empty clusters
